subject: INLA package not supported in R version 3.1.2 or later?

messages.author: eae15cf43570da55
messages.subject: INLA package not supported in R version 3.1.2 or later?
parts: I recently tried to install the INLA package using R version 3.1.2 that I have on my computer. However, it says that the package is not available in this version (or I'm assuming later versions of R either). Are there plans to make this available in later versions of R or is this just a problem on my computer?

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA package not supported in R version 3.1.2 or later?
parts: Finn

On 5 Jun 2015, at 02:26, Kelsey Osterloo <kelseyo...@gmail.com> wrote:

I recently tried to install the INLA package using R version 3.1.2 that I have on my computer. However, it says that the package is not available in this version (or I'm assuming later versions of R either). Are there plans to make this available in later versions of R or is this just a problem on my computer?

Please see
  http://www.r-inla.org/download
for installation instructions. The package is too complex to be on CRAN,  but can be easily installed from its own repositories.

Finn
